name: oxid-support/heartbeat
description: OXID eShop Heartbeat module with detailed request logging, correlation ID tracking, symbol monitoring, and GraphQL remote configuration

ignore.smarty/smarty: smarty 2.6 comes in transitively through oxideshop-ce -> oxideshop-unified-namespace-generator and has no fixed 2.x release, so it is ignored by package name: an advisory id list turns every new smarty 2.6 advisory into a red CI run. The dependency belongs to the shop core, not to this module.
ignore.PKSA-xwpn-zs9j-6wy5: webonyx/graphql-php 14.x comes in through graphql-base -> graphqlite 5 and has no fixed 14.x release. Ignored per advisory id and NOT per package name on purpose: this module ships the /graphql endpoint, so a new advisory for the parser has to turn CI red and reach a decision instead of passing unseen.

ignore.PKSA-yg4s-vh6g-jnyh: laminas/laminas-diactoros comes in through graphql-base 7 and caps at 2.17.0 on PHP 7.4, where CVE-2023-29530 (HTTP multiline header termination) has no fixed release: 2.18.1 and up need PHP 8. Ignored so the PHP 7.4 job can resolve at all. Inert on 8.0 and 8.1, they resolve an unaffected 2.26.0.
